name: Wort des Tages
tagline: Errate das Wort des Tages mit fünf Buchstaben in sechs Versuchen.
description: Spiele Wort des Tages kostenlos: errate das tägliche Wort mit fünf Buchstaben in sechs Versuchen, halte deine Serie und teile dein Raster.
about: Word of the Day is a daily word puzzle: guess the five-letter word in six tries. Type any word and press Enter, and each letter is marked: in the right place, in the word but somewhere else, or not in the word at all. Use what you learn to narrow it down before your tries run out.

Everyone gets the same word each day in their language, and a new one comes at midnight UTC. Solve it day after day to build your streak; your games, wins and how many tries they took are kept for you. When you're done, share your grid of colours with friends: it shows how you got there without giving away a single letter.

Want more? Practice gives you a random word as often as you like, and you can race friends in a room on the same word. Word of the Day is played in English and Bulgarian, with every guess checked against a full dictionary of the language.
howToPlay: Type a five-letter word and press Enter. It has to be a real word.
Each letter is marked: green with a bar if it's in the right place, yellow with a dot if it's in the word but elsewhere, grey if it isn't in the word.
A letter the word holds once is marked once, so a double letter in your guess can show one mark and one grey.
Find the word within six guesses. Today's word counts once a day towards your streak.
Points: 6 for finding the word at the first guess, 5 at the second, down to 1 at the sixth; nothing if you miss.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap the letters on the keyboard below, then Enter.
Keyboard: type the letters, Backspace to delete, Enter to guess.
In Bulgarian, a keyboard without Cyrillic types phonetically (A gives А), and the on-screen keyboard can switch between the phonetic and БДС layouts.
The keyboard's keys take the colours of your guesses, so you can see which letters are left.
tips: Start with a word that has several common letters, like vowels and R, S, T or N.
Use your second guess to test new letters rather than to win straight away.
Remember that letters can repeat: the answer may have two of the same.
A grey key means the letter is out: don't spend a guess on it again.
Practice is a good way to try out opening words without risking your streak.

faq.question: Is Word of the Day free?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: When does the word change?
faq.answer: At midnight UTC, the same moment for everyone. The menu shows how long until the next one.

faq.question: How is my streak kept?
faq.answer: With an account, on your profile, so it follows you to any device. As a guest, on this device. A streak counts the days in a row you solved the word.

faq.question: Does sharing give the word away?
faq.answer: No. What you share is only the grid of colours, with no letters.

faq.question: Can I play more than once a day?
faq.answer: Today's word counts once, but practice has a new random word as often as you like.
